note: The six fixed mission roles (ROADMAP §4.12, M9.9): the same for every mission. `writes` is every project path a role may write; the rest of the project is refused (bin/gate-mission-scope), so no mission role writes source and no builder writes docs/agents/mission/. `group` is the model route group (bin/_routes.py). At its stop, bin/gate-mission-artifact checks every artifact the role wrote (`mission <area> check`, once per artifact with the `area_checks` args where the area checks one; a `verdicts` state such as an ethics hard line is the role's finding, not a defect, and a `foreign` block such as a goal's pending ethics review is another role's next step) and refuses a change to another role's files: a file whose `role` field names a role is that role's (the Product Tester's own reports in `research/`, `research new --role product-tester`). `records` are the files a role's command writes beside its artifacts (a judge run log, a usage report): its work only when the command's own `event` of the run names the file (`ref`), checked by their area. A research snapshot belongs to the roles whose reports cite it. A track whose command makes one role write another role's dir changes `writes` here, with its reason. `ledger_bound` names a role's own commands that decide from the ledger, so they refuse while it is broken: a run of that role that wrote nothing on a ledger broken before it is a note, not a block (the Scout's `journeys retire`; `journeys approve` is the human's); mission-roles.test.py checks each one refuses, that the list holds every command the role's persona, eval suite or handout (the mission skill) names that refuses there, and that the Scout's `research` and `journeys new` do not.

market-researcher.job: Finds rival products, papers and benchmarks, writes a sourced landscape report (every claim cites an archived source), and derives the user journeys, metrics and pass criteria from it

product-tester.job: Runs rival products through the journeys on pinned versions and records what they score: the rival half of the baseline

state-assessor.job: Measures our own product with pinned scripts (journeys, the baseline measure, telemetry reports) and reports numbers only; never interprets

evaluator.job: Compares the current state with the baseline and the rivals and writes the gap list with goal_met; grades subjective UX only through pinned, hashed judge rubrics; never builds

mission-planner.job: Turns the top gaps into the next goal, applies the standing principles and the mission's mode, and hands the goal to Aladdin as intents

ethics-reviewer.job: Reviews the mission and every derived goal in three tiers: clear (proceed), gray (pause and ask; the consent is bound to that goal), hard line (no consent unlocks it)
